verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents creating and customizing many distinct Agents: the Agent Builder, Markdown-editable agent profiles, per-agent persistent memory, and connecting external agents. Its IM Gateway and Messenger docs (Telegram, Slack, Discord) put agents into chat channels, and multi-agent teams and shared-context Pages support running several agents side by side. missing for 10: explicit per-agent model selection, per-agent isolated workspaces (the documented Workspace is shared), detailed docs on routing specific channels or conversations to specific agents, independent hands-on corroboration.
